title: 1953 AHSME Problem 14
statement: Given the larger of two circles with center \(P\) and radius \(p\) and the smaller with center \(Q\) and radius \(q.\) Draw \(\overline{PQ}.\) Which of the following statements is false?

solutions.text:
Internal tangency realizes \(PQ=p-q,\) and external tangency realizes \(PQ=p+q.\) Disjoint circles can have \(PQ\gt p+q,\) and many intersecting or disjoint configurations have \(PQ\gt p-q.\) Thus each of A through D can occur, so none of them is false.

Therefore, the correct answer is E.
hints: Interpret the center distance for internal tangency, external tangency, and disjoint circles
For each of the first four statements, try to choose a valid relative position of the circles
